subject: Superintendent of Schools Contract Negotiations
overview: The School Committee convened for a special meeting primarily to enter an executive session regarding non-union personnel contract negotiations.

items.title: Opening Procedures
items.summary: The committee convened the remote meeting, established a quorum through roll call, and led the pledge of allegiance.

items.title: Executive Session for Superintendent Negotiations
items.summary: The committee approved entering executive session to conduct strategy for contract negotiations with the Superintendent of Schools. The body adjourned directly from executive session without returning to open session.
